Quick rules

How to play Ashen Duel

  1. On your turn, mana refills and grows by one. Draw one card.
  2. Click a card in your hand to summon a creature or cast a spell. Traps are set face down and trigger when attacked.

Built **Ashen Duel: The Last Draw** as a self-contained, playable card battler in `index.html`.

It includes three distinct champion decks—Artorias, Spawn, and Solaire—with signature cards, creature combat, spells, traps, an AI opponent, escalating duels, soul rewards, and a shop. Progress and purchases persist in the browser, and the layout adapts to mobile.

**Assumption:** “Yu-Gi-Oh based” means a turn-based dueling-card game, with original rules and Souls/Spawn-inspired characters rather than a direct ruleset or licensed art.
